description: Faith-based church trivia facts for the homepage Did You Know section

data.text: The smallest church in the United States is the Cross Island Chapel near Utica, New York. It seats only two people and sits on a tiny island in a pond.
The largest church building in the Christian world is St. Peter's Basilica in Vatican City. It can hold more than 60,000 people inside.
There are approximately 2.4 billion Christians in the world today, making Christianity the largest religion globally.
One of the oldest continuously used church buildings is located in Jordan and dates back to the 3rd century A.D.
The tallest church in the world is Ulm Minster in Germany, with a steeple reaching 530 feet high.
The United States has more churches than any other country, with over 380,000 churches nationwide.
Notre Dame Cathedral in Paris was the most visited church in the world before the fire, attracting over 13 million visitors per year.
Pentecostal and Charismatic Christianity is the fastest-growing Christian movement, especially in Africa, Latin America, and parts of Asia.
One of the largest Christian gatherings takes place in Nigeria, where some church events attract more than 5 million attendees.
Christian churches exist on every continent, including Antarctica, where chapels serve research stations.
